title: Role-store reconciliation and phased RBAC v2 migration runbook with admin-safety nets
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Execute a low-risk, observable migration from RBAC v1 role store to RBAC v2 canonical role store by running a phased reconciliation, dual-write shadow mode, and incrementally promoting customers with admin safety nets and clear rollback paths. Scope includes mapping SSO/SAML attributes into the new role model, ensuring audit log parity, creating production-ready verification queries, and operational runbooks for paging/rollback. Non-goals: changes to policy semantics, reauthoring existing service integrations, or full UI redesigns outside of admin emergency controls.
acceptance_criteria: Dual-write enabled for 100% of write paths with feature-flagged rollout and <0.01% write divergence rate over 48 hours in synthetic traffic
Automated backfill completes for 95% of accounts within time budget and reports remaining discrepancies in the reconciliation dashboard
End-to-end SSO mapping validated for top 50 customers via test tenants with documented attribute transformations
Audit events emitted from RBAC v2 match RBAC v1 for create/update/delete of roles and role-assignments for 30-day lookback sample
Canary promotion path exists with automated health gates and a one-click rollback that returns read/write routing to v1 within 5 minutes
tasks: Design reconciliation heuristics and idempotent backfill jobs (ENG backend)
Implement dual-write shim and metrics for divergence (serve/runtime team)
Add audit event parity layer and backfill audit-store (observability)
Create SSO attribute mapping library and test vectors (security/identity)
Build reconciliation dashboard and alert rules (console-observability)
Author customer communication templates and self-service verification steps (PM/CS)
Prepare emergency admin kill-switch and access gating (infra/ops)
Run synthetic dry-run and compare diffs; document anomalies (quality)
Execute canary promotions for internal tenants then opt-in pilot customers (customer-success)
Perform full migration cutover checklist and decommission dual-write after stable window
runbook_steps: Enable dual-write in shadow mode behind feature flag on staging and production read-paths
Start backfill job with snapshot sharding; monitor per-shard throughput and error rate
Run nightly reconciliation job; produce per-tenant discrepancy report and severity classification
Open canary cohort: move a small internal tenant to read from RBAC v2 while continuing writes to both stores
Validate authorization outcomes with automated end-to-end policy tests against canary cohort
If divergence > threshold, pause promotions and trigger investigation play (logs, last-successful-apply, reconciliation diff)
After 72 hours of stable canary, incrementally expand cohorts with staged customer opt-ins
When cohort coverage and divergence metrics satisfy release gates, flip read routing for remaining opt-in customers
Keep dual-write active for a minimum of 14 days post-read-flip and run final consistency sweep
Trigger deprecation window: notify customers 30/14/7 days before disabling legacy v1 write paths
If emergency rollback required, use admin kill-switch to restore legacy routing and run fast reconciler to re-sync state
verification_queries: Count of roles per-tenant on v1 vs v2: SELECT tenant_id, COUNT(*) FROM roles_v1 GROUP BY tenant_id vs roles_v2
Role assignment diff: query role_assignments left-join right where not equal and sample top-N tenants
Audit parity check: last_30_days_event_count_v1 == last_30_days_event_count_v2 for role events
SSO attribute hash comparisons for mapped attributes across test tenants
Policy decision parity: run policy-decision-caseset on v1 and v2 and compare verdicts for regressions
